name: Build a frontend custom block editor
query: Build a frontend modal block editor that saves a short note as serialized block markup.
expected_behavior: Identify the editor location, storage target, allowed blocks, media behavior, and permissions
Use BlockEditorProvider rather than EditorProvider for arbitrary block grammar
Start from a light composer surface unless the prompt asks for a full editor
Configure editor settings, nonce middleware, and media behavior explicitly
Verify save and reload without block recovery
